system:
You generate one self-contained, executable Modelica model.
Return Modelica code only, without markdown or prose. Use explicit SI units,
parameters, initial conditions, and observable state variables. Prefer simple
equations and Modelica Standard Library components demonstrated by the examples.
The top-level model must compile in OpenModelica. Standalone plant requests must
be directly simulatable and exportable as an FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation FMU. Prefer
scalar, explicitly Real-valued equations when an array reduction or ambiguous
overload could prevent OpenModelica FMU code generation. Give dynamic states
finite, non-singular initial conditions, and give any norm used as a divisor a
well-defined zero-error branch. Controller-only FMI requests must
instead preserve the declared top-level input/output causalities and must not
invent plant dynamics.
Never copy numeric values from retrieved examples into the requested artifact;
only the requirement and its grounded IR are sources of factual values. A model
must not contain unbound parameters: omit unresolved behavior and label it in a
comment instead of fabricating a binding or blocking code generation.
human:
Generate one complete Modelica model for this requirement:
Build a verifiable free-base aerial robot named TiltWingSurveyE. The resulting scenario must make the following behavior testable: Track 3D waypoints [0,0,1.5], [4,0,2.5], [4,3,2.5], and [1,4,2] m at declared deadlines. Represent the plant without omitting its structure. A 6.2 kg capsule fuselage carries two tilting rotors 0.62 m from center and a 1.8 m-span wing; rotor tilt joints travel from 0 rad to 1.57 rad. Two thrust channels and two tilt-joint actuators support hover-to-flight transition, with command magnitude bounded by 57.2 N-per-rotor. Fuse IMU, GPS, altimeter, and camera timestamps into pose and velocity estimates. Place three fixed cylindrical obstacles outside the reference polyline. Apply bounded waypoint tracking with feedforward acceleration and a controlled 7.2 N crosswind middle-third disturbance. Run at 250 Hz for 16 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Acceptance is fail-closed. Require thrust and attitude bounds, waypoint error, estimator finiteness, and no collision, primary tracking error below 0.315 m after 10.4 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.
